title: Replay counter APIs accept booleans and inconsistently reject non-integers
description: Correctness review: replay logical_counter validates only numeric ranges, so bool is accepted as epoch/sequence and floats or other types can fail later with inconsistent shift/type errors. Enforce exact-int (excluding bool) validation before range checks and apply it consistently through ReplayWindow and ReplayProtector public methods. Add boundary tests for zero, maxima, bool, float, and string inputs across logical_counter, check, commit, and check_and_update.
